## Review Comment

### Module / Section
Which part of the standard does this comment relate to?
- [ ] Core Module
- [ ] Provenance Module
- [ ] Quality Module
- [ ] Cultural Heritage Module
- [ ] Compliance Module
- [ ] JSON Schema
- [ ] Overall Architecture

### Comment Type
- [ ] Technical concern (spec feasibility, interoperability)
- [ ] Clarity / editorial (unclear wording, missing explanation)
- [ ] Gap identification (missing consideration, edge case)
- [ ] Suggestion for improvement
- [ ] Support / endorsement

### Your Comment
Please provide your detailed feedback.

### Proposed Alternative (if any)
If you have a specific suggestion for how to address this, please describe it.

### Your Affiliation (optional)
Organization / Role — this helps us understand the perspective of the feedback.

> All comments submitted during the public review period (ending **2026-08-20**) will be reviewed by the DPP-CQ working group. Thank you for contributing to the development of this standard.
